title: IdeaSeek ResearchMap (research-map-v1)
description: Structural contract for the map reduced over a run's topic syntheses, a sound subset of validateResearchMap (src/knowledge/synthesis.ts). `required` holds only the keys the prompt asks the model for AND that survive into the artifact; inputHash, generator and generatedAt are stamped by the worker (src/worker/synthesis-handlers.ts) and never sent by the model, so they are typed but not required — one file validates the raw harness answer and the persisted knowledge/research-map alike; citations stays optional too, because the writer substitutes the topic papers whenever the model omits it. Whether a citation resolves to an indexed paper, whether lineages/gaps really trace to a cited input and how inputHash is reduced over topic hashes stay in TypeScript.

lineages.description: Non-empty is enforced by validateResearchMap and nothing repairs it. The prompt asks for {name, summary} and renderResearchMap reads both keys, yet the validator only checks Array.isArray and length — a model answering with plain lineages strings is accepted today, so no element constraint is encoded here.

conflicts.description: May be honestly empty. The prompt asks for {topic, detail} objects while the input payload feeds the model plain strings, and validateResearchMap checks only Array.isArray, so no element constraint is encoded here.

citations.description: Not required: the writer replaces an absent or empty list with the synthesized papers, so a model that omits it is repaired rather than invalid — hence no minimum count either. Per-item source+title is what validateResearchMap checks whenever the model does supply entries.
